body_markdown:
Søren Steenberg Jensen has today, 1 September 2026, assumed the role of Chief Executive Officer at Hafnia, succeeding Mikael Skov.


Notice is hereby given that an Extraordinary General Meeting of Hafnia to appoint Mikael Skov as a Director of the Company will be conducted on the 23rd of September 2026.


Hafnia thanks Mikael for his remarkable leadership. We wish our extended congratulations to Søren and wish him every success in his new role.
